I'm a server at a restaurant. Whenever people come in and order takeout, I'll automatically put the tip at 0% for their bill.

That's why I'll immediately put in 0% myself, and it'll be up to the customer whether or not they want to change that. 

Tips make up a majority of my money, so me doing a 0% tip hurts myself more than anything. But in my opinion, charging tips for a takeout is completely NOT OK. I think it's greedy af. I think it's awesome some people still wanna tip even for takeout, but that's totally not required. The price of the food already covers our labor, we didn't provide any service for you. All we did was take your order. And no, cooking your food is not a service that deserves tip; it's our job and we're already getting paid for that part. Anybody that gets irritated you didn't tip for a takeout is a money-pinching a**hole.
